headline: Net profit rises on year and quarter
summary_short: Net income to owners was KRW 792.4B, up 9.6% y/y and 14.8% q/q, and operating profit was KRW 937.7B, up 14.9% y/y.
summary_long: Nine-month net income to owners reached KRW 2,685.9B, up 26.9% y/y, already above the full-year 2025 total. EPS was KRW 4,412 against KRW 4,026 a year ago. Total consolidated net income was KRW 823.9B. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
